per_source: Confirm canonical website and current operating status
Find official documented API or syndication/feed
Inspect JSON-LD schema.org Event and server-rendered event pages
Inspect public calendar pages, sitemaps and permitted network endpoints
Review robots.txt, terms, rate limits, authentication and reuse permissions
Determine event horizon, update cadence, stable identifiers and cancellations
Estimate extraction quality and engineering cost
Recommend ingest method: official_api, rss_ical, structured_html, permitted_scrape, editorial_llm, manual, or skip

deduplication: Canonical event URL + performer/production + venue + local start time; allow multiple source observations and preserve provenance.
